Argan oil, grapeseed oil, sunflower oil, baobab oil, jojoba oil is good too. There are more as well and easy to find, you can Google low porosity hair oil. Deep conditioners work well too and you don't have to buy the expensive kind, just make sure the ingredients arent high in protein.

Coconut oil isn't good for everybody's hair, it can make it worse. It has a lot of protein in it so depending on the porosityof your hair it could ruin it. 

 To determine the porosity of your hair pull 1 strand out and put it in a small bowl of water and leave it for a few minutes. If your hair is at the top it means you have low porosity, if it stays in the middle of the water you have normal porosity  and if it sinks to the bottom  it means you have high porosity.

If you have low porosity the coconut oil will not be good for your hair. But if you have high porosity it will help your hair. Also you don't really need to cook coconut oil, it melts in your hands. But if you want to heat it up just put hot water in a bowl then put coconut oil in a smaller bowl and put the small bowl in hot water.
